root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the `IS_RAW` fallback path, `ZSTD_decodeLiteralsBlock()` must reject any block with `litSize > BLOCKSIZE` before copying raw literals into `dctx->litBuffer`. The vulnerable code only enforces the remaining-input check `litSize <= srcSize-3`, so an oversized raw-literals segment can still reach `memcpy()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing `BLOCKSIZE` cap on `litSize` immediately before the fallback raw-literals copy into the fixed `dctx->litBuffer` scratch array.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The original fixed run is guarded because the added `litSize > BLOCKSIZE` rejection prevents `raw_copy_sink`. The closest boundary perturbation `lit_size_blocksize_fallback_boundary` makes the protected copy execute with `litSize == BLOCKSIZE`, which supplies the genuine fixed witness required by the validator.

nodes.state: At the `memcpy` sink, the copy byte count `litSize` exceeds `sizeof(dctx->litBuffer)`, so the fallback raw-literals copy overruns the fixed scratch array inside stack `ctx`.

edges.relation: The same unchecked raw-literals length `litSize` observed at the missing `BLOCKSIZE` guard is passed unchanged as the byte-count argument to `memcpy(dctx->litBuffer, istart, litSize)`.
